objective: Resolve this customer refund request. The customer wrote: 'My mechanical keyboard (order ORD-5002) stopped working. Please refund me the $80 I paid.'
acceptance_criteria: Refund policy: refunds are allowed only within 30 days of purchase; the refund amount must NOT exceed the order total; if the order is outside the window, escalate to a human instead of refunding. Take the correct action per policy.
context: You may issue a refund or escalate. The order total, currency and days since purchase are in the facts. Do not refund outside the policy window even if the request sounds reasonable.
